title: 第十九章 击鼓鸣冤第二十章 抓人立刻抓人
lines: 武氏子弟历史上祸害极多，武承嗣，武三思等人都是罪大恶极之人。而这一次到合宫县的武攸敏，名气比不上前面几人，可是一肚子坏水却是一点不逊色。
纨绔膏粱子弟好色是人之常情，武攸敏不仅好色，而且癖好独特，喜欢****女，在洛州一带，他的恶名很盛，百姓怨恨，奈何武氏太强，大家对他无可奈何，让他愈发无法无天。
魏生明和武攸敏其实并不算太熟悉，但是他抓住了武攸敏的嗜好，用色诱之，武攸敏果然来了合宫县，而且初来乍到，便在合宫县惹出了轩然大波。
合宫县县吏强二郎的媳妇儿被人强抢，强二郎带兄弟找上门去论理，不仅没有讨回公道，自己反而身陷囹圄，这事儿在合宫县传开，百姓能不人心浮动？
合宫县衙里面，此时也是一片大乱，朱恩拽着王瞎子，两人一起到了岳峰的住处，到了地方王瞎子便哭：
“岳首领，强哥的性子您知道，我苦劝不住，他听闻嫂子被人抢去了整个人都疯了，抄起家伙就往绣春坊去了，这不是白白去送死么？
那姓武的是什么身份？我等普通小吏怎么惹得起？眼下落到这一步境地，强哥几人固然完了，恐怕连首领我们一起也要受牵连，局面危矣！”
岳峰阴沉着脸，一大早他已经听到了报告，知道了昨天事情的前因后果，他盯着王瞎子，眼睛落在朱恩身上道：“朱恩，你说这件事该怎么办？”
朱恩阴着脸道：“岳大哥，有道是退一步海阔天空，留得青山在，不愁没柴烧，暂时忍耐，他日再缓缓图之是上策！”
岳峰“咣当”一下将手中的茶杯摔在地上，道：“狗屁，媳妇被人抢了还能忍气吞声，这等活着和畜生何异？按照你们的意思，强子现在陷入了囹圄，我们就不管不顾了，不仅要和他划清界限，甚至还要为自己想后路，准备脚底抹油开溜？”
朱恩满脸通红低下了头，王瞎子嘴唇掀动欲言又止，岳峰瞅着两人，心中忽然生出一种莫名的压抑。
按照岳峰的世界观，自己的妻女被辱，如同父母被杀，豁出命去也要报仇，这不存在有任何的争议。可是在大唐人的思想里面，媳妇不过是个女人而已，女人丢了能保住命才是首要。对方是权贵万万不能得罪，因为那可是要送命的，大唐的等级森严，武氏治下的残酷凶险更是甚于其他的权贵，和武氏作对是自寻死路。
“今日是强子被欺，明日保不准你们也遇到这等事，我姓岳的可能也会遭遇这等事，难不成我们都只能忍气吞声，忍辱苟活么？”岳峰冷冷的道，语气变得悲凉：
“倘若真是如是，人和家畜便真无异议！”
朱恩豁然抬头看着岳峰道：“岳大哥，您说怎么办？我朱恩也不是舍不得这条命，只要能救得了强子，就算舍一条命也无妨，可是……就怕搭上了命也无济于事……”
岳峰阴着脸道：“王瞎子，你去县衙门口击鼓喊冤，先把事情捅大再说！事已至此，我们只能放手一搏！”
岳峰沉吟了一下，继续道：“你们都给我听好了，这事儿不是别人的事儿，全是自己的事儿！因为这件事背后的始作俑者就是魏生明！
你们想想吧，倘若我们真退了，这个‘活阎罗’能够放过我们？在他的眼中，我们都是他的仇人！我们有一个算一个，他都不会让我们活！”
岳峰这话一说，朱恩和王瞎子脸色瞬间变得煞白，眼神中浮现出惊恐之意。岳峰摆摆手道：“你们去吧，朱恩负责把这事儿的利害关系给大家传递清楚，王瞎子你负责喊冤！”
岳峰快刀斩乱麻，心中瞬间有了决断，王瞎子不敢犹豫，跑到县衙门口开始击鼓鸣冤，鼓声一下，县衙震动，县丞周柔和主薄傅游艺两人再也不能装傻了。
还有，县城的百姓听闻有人击鼓鸣冤，都齐齐汇聚过来看热闹，朱恩又在暗中把这一次强子的遭遇说成是魏生明作祟，一时县衙上下的气氛立刻便紧张起来。
周柔升堂，将王瞎子叫到堂上问话，王瞎子便把昨天强子等人的怨屈一一呈上，周柔一听作恶之人乃武氏子弟武攸敏，头一下就大了。他的能力本就庸碌，对刑案司狱也不熟，胆量更是小得很，武氏子弟他哪里敢惹？
关键时候，他只能去依靠老师傅游艺，傅游艺从东都回来，正春风得意马蹄疾，乍听这事儿，忍不住一声惊呼，当即冒出一声冷汗。
他这等老狐狸岂能不知道这件事的轻重？这事儿倘若处理不好，他的名头必然大大的受损，如果那样，于他而言，他的升官大计就要遭遇搁浅了。
“周柔误我啊！这种事情咋能拖到这步田地？现在……现在难了哇！”傅游艺道，周柔道：“老师，事已至此，我们是不是要有所举动？老师刚刚得了拾遗之职，您大可将此事上书天后，我相信天后一定能有公断！”
“啊？”傅游艺惊得跳了起来，他盯着周柔，像是第一次才认识他一般。我的天，现在是什么时候？武氏欲要称帝，现在是各方势力博弈角逐最激烈的时候，在这个时候武氏还会过问这等鸡毛蒜皮的事儿？
这个时候武氏为了维护本家的权威，别说是武攸敏抢民间女子，就算武攸敏把某位不知名的公主给抢了，她估计也要将事情抹平，这是政治决定的！
周柔身在官场，对这些种种竟然一窍不通，说出的话如此天真，傅游艺心中真只能哀叹。
“得了，得了，此事你暂时先敷衍着！快，快来人，给我把岳峰叫过来！”傅游艺真是捶胸顿足，他正要有所作为的时候，竟然出了这等幺蛾子，他心中岂能不叹？
周柔也有些慌，道：“傅师啊，现在不好敷衍了，此时证据确凿，县衙大堂外面便有诸多百姓在围观，他们都等着看我们的决断呢！您说这……不能等啊。”
傅游艺心中一阵烦躁，吼道：“你就说你得了急症，先得歇息半个时辰再审案子行不行？”
傅游艺心头冒火，岳峰恰在这时候踏步进来了，看他的样子，神情平静，一如既往的老持沉稳，傅游艺烦躁的心思才稍稍减弱。
content_en:
The children of the Wu family have caused many disasters in history. Wu Chengsi, Wu Sansi and others were all guilty of heinous crimes. Wu Youmin, who came to Hegong County this time, was not as famous as the previous ones, but he was no less famous for his bad intentions.
It is human nature for a dandy to be lustful. Wu Youmin is not only lustful, but also has unique hobbies and likes promiscuous women. In the Luozhou area, he has a very bad reputation and the people are resentful. However, the Wu family is too strong and everyone has no choice but to do anything to him, making him even more lawless.
In fact, Wei Shengming and Wu Youmin were not very familiar with each other, but he caught Wu Youmin's hobby and used sex to lure her. As expected, Wu Youmin came to Hegong County, and when he first arrived, he caused an uproar in Hegong County.
The daughter-in-law of a county magistrate in Hegong County, Qiang Erlang, was robbed. Qiang Erlang and his brothers went to the house to argue with him. Not only did he not seek justice, but he himself was imprisoned. When this story spread in Hegong County, how could the people not be upset?
Inside the Hegong County Government Office, there was also chaos at this time. Zhu En dragged Blind Man Wang, and the two of them went to Yue Feng's residence together. When they got there, Blind Man Wang cried:
"Chief Yue, you know Brother Qiang's temper. I can't help it. When he heard that his sister-in-law was robbed, he went crazy. He picked up the guy and went to Xiuchunfang. Wasn't he going to die in vain?
What is the identity of the person named Wu? How can I, an ordinary petty official, offend me? Now that we are in this situation, although Brother Qiang and the others are doomed, I am afraid that even the leader and we will be implicated as well. The situation is dangerous! "
Yue Feng had a gloomy face. He had heard the report early in the morning and knew the cause and effect of yesterday's incident. He stared at Blind Wang, his eyes fell on Zhu En and said: "Zhu En, what do you think we should do about this matter?"
Zhu En said with a gloomy face: "Brother Yue, the right way is to take a step back to open up the sea and leave the green mountains. Don't worry about running out of firewood. It's best to be patient for the time being and take it easy in the future!"
Yue Feng slammed the tea cup in his hand to the ground with a bang and said: "Bullshit, my wife was robbed and she could endure it. How is this life any different from an animal? According to your opinion, Qiangzi is now in jail, so we will just ignore him. Not only do we have to draw a clear line with him, but we even have to think of a way out for ourselves and prepare to run away with oil on our feet?"
Zhu En lowered his head with his face flushed, while Blind Wang moved his lips but hesitated to speak. Yue Feng looked at the two of them, and suddenly felt an inexplicable depression in his heart.
According to Yue Feng's world view, if his wife and daughter are humiliated, it is like his parents being killed, and he must risk his life to take revenge. There is no dispute about this. But in the minds of the Tang Dynasty people, a daughter-in-law is just a woman, and the first priority is to save a woman's life if she is lost. You must not offend the other party if he is a powerful person, because it will lead to death. The hierarchy in the Tang Dynasty is strict, and the cruelty and danger under Wu's rule are even more cruel and dangerous than other powerful people. Going against Wu is asking for death.
"Today, a strong man was bullied. I guarantee that something like this will happen to you tomorrow. My surname is Yue. It may also happen to me. Could it be that we all just have to swallow our anger and live with humiliation?" Yue Feng said coldly, his tone becoming sad:
"If that were the case, there would really be no objection between humans and domestic animals!"
Zhu En suddenly raised his head and looked at Yue Feng and said: "Brother Yue, what do you think we should do? I, Zhu En, am not reluctant to give up this life. As long as I can save Qiangzi, it doesn't matter even if I give up my life, but...it won't help if I am afraid of taking my own life..."
Yue Feng said with a sullen face: "Blind Wang, you go to the county government office to play drums and cry out for injustice. First make the matter bigger! Now that the matter has come to this, we can only give it a try!"
Yue Feng pondered for a moment and continued: "You all listen to me, this matter is no one else's business, it is all your own business! Because the initiator behind this matter is Wei Shengming!
Think about it, if we really retreat, can this 'Living Yama' let us go? In his eyes, we are all his enemies! No matter how many of us there are, he won’t let us live! "
As soon as Yue Feng said this, Zhu En and Wang Xiazi's faces instantly turned pale, with panic in their eyes. Yue Feng waved his hand and said: "You go ahead, Zhu En is responsible for conveying the stakes of this matter clearly to everyone, and Blind Wang, you are responsible for calling out the injustice!"
Yue Feng cut through the mess with a sharp knife, and instantly made a decision in his heart. Blind Wang did not dare to hesitate, ran to the door of the county government office and started beating drums to express his grievances. With the sound of the drum, the county government office was shaken. County Prime Minister Zhou Rou, Master Bo Fu Youyi and the two could no longer pretend to be stupid.
Also, when the people in the county heard that someone was beating drums to complain, they all gathered to watch the excitement. Zhu En secretly said that Wei Shengming was responsible for Qiangzi's encounter, and the atmosphere in the county government immediately became tense.
Zhou Rou went to the hall and called Blind Wang to the hall for questioning. Blind Wang then presented the grievances of Qiangzi and others yesterday one by one. When Zhou Rou heard that the evildoer was Wu Youmin, a descendant of the Wu family, her head was pounding. His ability is mediocre, he is not familiar with criminal cases, and his courage is very small. How can he dare to provoke a child of the Wu family?
At the critical moment, he could only rely on his master Youyi. When Fu Youyi came back from Dongdu, he was riding a horse in the spring breeze. When he heard about this, he couldn't help but exclaimed and broke into a cold sweat.
How could an old fox like him not know the seriousness of this matter? If this matter is not handled well, his reputation will be greatly damaged. If so, for him, his promotion plan will be stranded.
"Zhou Rou misunderstood me! How could this kind of thing be dragged out to this point? Now...it's so difficult now!" Fu Youyi said, Zhou Ju said: "Teacher, the matter has come to this, do we have to do something? The teacher just got the job of collecting artifacts, you can write this matter to the Queen of Heaven, I believe the Queen of Heaven will make a decision!"
"Ah?" Fu Youyi jumped up in shock. He stared at Zhou Rou as if he was meeting him for the first time. Oh my God, what time is it now? The Wu family wants to become emperor, and now is the time when the competition between the various forces is at its most intense. At this time, the Wu family would still care about such trivial matters?
At this time, in order to maintain the authority of the family, the Wu family, let alone Wu Youmin robbing a private woman, even if Wu Youmin robbed an unknown princess, she would probably have to smooth things over. This is a political decision!
Zhou Rou was in the officialdom, but she didn't know anything about all these things. What she said was so naive, Fu Youyi could only lament in her heart.
"Come on, come on, you can deal with this for now! Come on, come on, call Yue Feng!" Fu Youyi was really beating his chest. Just when he was about to do something, something like this happened. How could he not sigh in his heart?
Zhou Rou was also a little panicked and said: "Master, it's hard to be perfunctory now. The evidence is solid now. There are many people watching outside the county government hall. They are all waiting to see our decision! You said... we can't wait."
Fu Youyi felt agitated and yelled, "Can you just say that you have an emergency and need to rest for half an hour before trying the case?"
Fu Youyi was furious when Yue Feng stepped in just at this moment. Judging from his appearance, his expression was calm and calm as always, so Fu Youyi's irritable thoughts subsided slightly.
title_en: Chapter 19 Beating Drums to Reveal Wrongs Chapter 20 Arrest People Arrest People Immediately
